# ENV Var Settings

This mod sets Transmission settings provided via environment variables.

Add it to the `transmission` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:transmission-env-var-settings
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:transmission-env-var-settings|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

The environment variable names are a combination of `'TRANSMISSION_'` and the
setting name capitalized with hyphens (`'-'`) converted to underscores (`'_'`). For example, the setting
`'peer-port'` can be set with environment variable `TRANSMISSION_PEER_PORT`.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/transmission-env-var-settings/
